title: Add two numbers
summary: Assembly: Add two numbers. Add 4 instead.
introduction: add changes its first register by adding the second value. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Add two numbers
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 3
    add rdi, 2
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: add changes rdi from 3 to 5 before exit reads it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The add instruction changes the destination register.
